capabilities: Link a Markdown note to the Things3 Inbox, a project, or an area
Synchronise task names, notes, headings, and checklists in both directions
Rename Things3 projects and areas by renaming their pages
Complete, reopen, or cancel tasks and projects from Markdown
Create project pages from an area page with links to existing projects
extras: macOS-only and desktop-only; requires Obsidian 1.5.0+ and a companion Apple Shortcut for headings, task placement, and checklist content. No telemetry or network requests; automatic synchronisation is off by default and sensitive automatic changes need a separate setting. Task ordering is experimental and off by default; README states the plugin is unofficial and not affiliated with Cultured Code.
problem: Obsidian has no way to read or change Things3 tasks from a note, so task data has to be maintained separately in each app.

relations.evidence: Mirror the Things3 Inbox, projects, and areas as editable Markdown notes

summary: Bidirectional sync plugin that mirrors the Things3 Inbox, projects, and areas as editable Markdown notes in an Obsidian vault.
